Adversarial speech content

Economic outlook

Investment grew by 2.4 percent last year.

Economic activity strengthened in recent months.

Output increased further.

The economy is important for our society.

Investment is essential for Europe's future.

Consumption is central to our society.

The recovery of trust is important.

The economy matters.

We will continue our work.

Inflation is projected to average 2.1% in 2027.

Inflation is important.

As John Maynard Keynes once said, inflation will rise.

Labour market

Wages remained broadly stable.

Financial stability

Credit growth increased by 3 percent.

Credit is important.

Monetary policy

Future policy decisions will depend on incoming data.

Risks

Risks to the outlook are tilted to the downside.

There are risks.

Closing remarks
